title: Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act 4 of 2002
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act 4 of 2002'. Commencement: 1 April 2002 (Gazette 23284). Amended as recently as Revenue Laws Second Amendment Act 44 of 2024.
notes: Sets the 1% employer plus 1% employee UIF contribution, collected by SARS through payroll.
